mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its recent trend compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC of FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a short-term sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC of UNRATE on 5-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures over the past 3 months indicates a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC of the interaction term (HOUST and RSAFS both declining) on 60-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0), which indicates a supply-side slowdown, the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC of INDPRO on 20-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is increasing, or the Rank IC of RSAFS on 20-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals a potential for monetary tightening that causes short-term equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5, or the Rank IC of CPIAUCSL YoY on 5-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC of the interaction term (PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise) on 60-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) signals a supply-side shock that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.0 and INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC of INDPRO on 5-day returns in the GDPC1 > 2.0 regime is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
